a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def absolute(a):
    return a if a >= 0 else -a

r = 1e100
ansx, ansy = 0, 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    x = i
    y1 = int((a / b) * i)
    y0 = y1 + 1
    diff1 = absolute((a / b) - (y1 / x))
    if r > diff1:
        ansx, ansy = y1, x
        r = diff1
    diff2 = absolute((a / b) - (y0 / x))
    if r > diff2:
        ansx, ansy = y0, x
        r = diff2

print(f"{ansx}/{ansy}")
